# Dojo Genesis Plugins

> Plugins and mods for Claude Code that put the right model on each job, keep context small, and don't call work done until a check passes. 114 skills across 20 plugins: the Dojo protocol suite, a library of practice skills, and two companions.

## What this is

The `dojo-genesis` Claude Code marketplace, source `DojoGenesis/plugins`. Genius-level protocol and inexpensive inference go together: Claude Code without protocol is messy, costly and inaccurate, so each suite plugin makes one problem stop happening by a mechanism (a hook, a pinned agent, a workflow, a report), not by advice alone. The suite comes first; the library and companions are the practice skills that were here before it. Skills are structured scaffolds in SKILL.md format with YAML frontmatter; the library is designed to work with the Dojo MCP Server and Claude Code.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add DojoGenesis/plugins
/plugin install dojo-suite@dojo-genesis
```

Or one at a time, e.g. `/plugin install dojo-gates@dojo-genesis`. Mods are early access: set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1` (or add it under `env` in `~/.claude/settings.json`), then install dojo-meter. Kill switches: `DOJO_OFF=1` turns off the whole suite, `DOJO_<PLUGIN>_OFF=1` one plugin. Counts here are checked against disk by `scripts/face-parity.py`; measured figures and their method are at https://dojogenesis.com/proof.

## Plugins (20)

### Suite

- **dojo-suite** — All eight Dojo suite plugins in one install: protocol, gates, router, meter, verify, flow, doctor and settle. Adds no skills, agents or hooks of its own.
- **dojo-protocol** — The Dojo Protocol for Claude Code: ten rules at session start, a scout→contract→build→verify spine, and role agents pinned to the right model.
- **dojo-gates** — Deterministic guards for the mistakes that waste a day: blanket staging, rewriting pushed commits, printing secrets, oversized reads, silent probes.
- **dojo-router** — No subagent silently inherits your most expensive model. Warns or blocks unpinned dispatches; the mod routes them by role.
- **dojo-meter** — See what each turn, agent and model costs, and how big your context is: a cost report from your transcripts, and a live band with the mod.
- **dojo-verify** — "Done" means a check ran and passed in this session. Flags claims of success with no evidence behind them.
- **dojo-flow** — Parallel builds that stay independent: a contract gate, scouts on small models, builders in the middle, judges at the ends, and a scorecard that counts returns.
- **dojo-doctor** — Find the hooks and settings that fail or cost you silently: broken interpreters, noisy injections, always-on token weight, flags that are off.
- **dojo-settle** — Settle claims with evidence: pre-registered experiments, with/without baselines and decision gates before anything becomes a number.

### Library

- **agent-orchestration** — Multi-agent coordination patterns, parallel dispatch, delegation playbooks
- **continuous-learning** — Research modes, project exploration, synthesis, retrospectives, era architecture
- **skill-forge** — Skill creation, maintenance, batch normalization, community skill scanning
- **specification-driven-development** — Spec writing, parallel tracks, frontend-from-backend, implementation prompts
- **strategic-thinking** — Strategic scout, product positioning, iterative scouting, multi-surface strategy
- **system-health** — Documentation audit, health audit, observability dashboard, repo status, budget guard
- **wisdom-garden** — Memory garden, compression ritual, seed extraction, system prompt archaeology
- **pretext-pdf** — PDF export, typography configuration for AI-generated documents
- **dojo-craft** — Practitioner's workbench: strategic thinking, codebase intelligence, memory curation, project governance

### Companions

- **bring-loop** — Gate the outward loop: one send/decision/close a day, agent stages, human executes, honest separate streams (canonical: github.com/DojoGenesis/bring-loop)
- **kata-harness** — Roll the bring queue one tick at a time: bounded, self-terminating sessions (reps or minutes) over the same bring/ queue, opt-in timer display, session ledger folded fresh on every read (source: this repository)

## Clusters

12 behavioral clusters cross-cut the plugins — skills grouped by what they
*do*, not just which plugin ships them. Every registered skill's `category:`
frontmatter is one of these 12 ids (enforced by `scripts/plugin-lint.py`).
Flags: **DUP** = near-duplicate of another member (see README's twin-skill
table for the boundary between them), **MISFILED** = the skill's function
belongs to this cluster even though its plugin doesn't, **X** = the skill's
function legitimately spans plugins.

**These flags are descriptive, not a to-do list.** A MISFILED or DUP skill is
grouped by its `category:` metadata and these tables — it is deliberately NOT
physically relocated. Moving a skill to "fix" its cluster changes its invoke
name (`plugin:skill`) and breaks every caller, so cluster membership is carried
by metadata, never by directory location. (This was tried once — moving
`mcp-builder` and `supply-chain-refresh` into `skill-forge` — and reverted for
exactly this reason; they stay in `system-health`.)

- **scout-position** — strategic-thinking:strategic-scout, strategic-thinking:iterative-scouting, strategic-thinking:product-positioning, strategic-thinking:multi-surface-strategy, strategic-thinking:strategic-to-tactical-workflow, dojo-craft:scout-writer (DUP of strategic-thinking:strategic-scout), dojo-protocol:scout-first
- **specify-commission** — specification-driven-development:specification-writer, specification-driven-development:release-specification, specification-driven-development:frontend-from-backend, specification-driven-development:codebase-audit-grounding, specification-driven-development:context-ingestion, specification-driven-development:planning-with-files, specification-driven-development:pre-implementation-checklist, specification-driven-development:pre-commission-alignment, specification-driven-development:implementation-prompt, specification-driven-development:zenflow-prompt-writer, specification-driven-development:spec-constellation-to-prompt-suite, specification-driven-development:parallel-tracks, specification-driven-development:gap-audit-then-fix, continuous-learning:era-architecture (MISFILED), dojo-protocol:contract
- **dispatch-coordinate** — agent-orchestration:agent-dispatch-playbook, agent-orchestration:parallel-dispatch, agent-orchestration:async-agent-dispatch, agent-orchestration:audit-sweep-dispatch, agent-orchestration:maestro-orchestration, agent-orchestration:orchestration-pattern-selector, agent-orchestration:workflow-router, agent-orchestration:handoff-protocol, agent-orchestration:agent-teaching, agent-orchestration:workspace-navigation, agent-orchestration:granular-visibility, agent-orchestration:decision-propagation, dojo-protocol:protocol, dojo-protocol:delegate, dojo-router:router, dojo-flow:dag-plan
- **remember-continue** — wisdom-garden:memory-garden, wisdom-garden:compression-ritual, wisdom-garden:session-compression, wisdom-garden:continuity-ledger, wisdom-garden:reflect-and-learn, wisdom-garden:session-lifecycle-automation, dojo-craft:memory-curator (DUP of wisdom-garden:memory-garden)
- **seed-lifecycle** — wisdom-garden:seed-extraction, wisdom-garden:seed-library, wisdom-garden:seed-to-skill-converter, dojo-craft:seed-curator (DUP of wisdom-garden:seed-extraction)
- **system-prompt-intel** — wisdom-garden:ingest-system-prompt, wisdom-garden:system-prompt-archaeology, wisdom-garden:analyze-agent-behavior, wisdom-garden:build-intelligence-map
- **repo-docs-health** — system-health:health-audit, system-health:documentation-audit, system-health:build-sweep, system-health:convergence-gate, system-health:claude-md-guardian, system-health:pointer-directories, system-health:repo-context-sync, system-health:semantic-clusters, system-health:repo-status, system-health:status-template, system-health:status-writing, system-health:skill-audit-upgrade (X), dojo-craft:convergence-checker (DUP of system-health:convergence-gate), dojo-craft:community-claude-md-guardian (DUP of system-health:claude-md-guardian), strategic-thinking:adversarial-reviewer (MISFILED), dojo-protocol:refute
- **agent-telemetry** — system-health:observability-dashboard, system-health:observability-dashboard-spec, system-health:tool-intercept-logger, system-health:agent-performance-report, system-health:budget-guard, dojo-doctor:doctor
- **learn-research** — continuous-learning:research-modes, continuous-learning:research-synthesis, continuous-learning:web-research, continuous-learning:web-research-external, continuous-learning:patient-learning-protocol, continuous-learning:retrospective, continuous-learning:debugging, dojo-settle:settle, dojo-settle:eval-kit
- **understand-codebase** — continuous-learning:codebase-cartography, continuous-learning:tldr-code-analysis, continuous-learning:project-exploration, continuous-learning:figma-to-code (MISFILED), continuous-learning:design-system-selector (MISFILED), dojo-craft:codebase-viewer (DUP of continuous-learning:codebase-cartography — placed here, not in repo-docs-health, to match its DUP target's cluster)
- **forge** — skill-forge:skill-creation, skill-forge:process-extraction, skill-forge:skill-maintenance, skill-forge:normalize-community-skill, skill-forge:scan-community-repos, skill-forge:batch-normalize-and-package, skill-forge:file-management, skill-forge:mcp-server-builder, skill-forge:mcp-cloudflare-builder, system-health:mcp-builder (MISFILED), system-health:supply-chain-refresh (MISFILED), system-health:hooks-reference (X), wisdom-garden:voice-before-structure (X)
- **govern-publish** — dojo-craft:adr-writer, dojo-craft:project-scaffolder, pretext-pdf:pdf-export, pretext-pdf:pdf-typography, bring-loop:bring, bring-loop:bring-setup, kata-harness:kata-harness, kata-harness:kata-harness-setup, dojo-gates:gates, dojo-verify:evidence, dojo-settle:decision-gate

## Skill format

Each skill lives at `plugins/{plugin-name}/skills/{skill-name}/SKILL.md` with YAML frontmatter containing:
- `name`, `description` — what the skill is and when to use it
- `category` — one of the 12 cluster ids (enforced by `scripts/plugin-lint.py`)
- `model` — recommended Claude model (sonnet/opus split)
- `inputs` / `outputs` — the skill's typed input/output contract
- Full workflow steps as markdown

## How to use with LLMs

Install via the Dojo MCP Server (`DOJO_SKILLS_PATH` pointing to this repo). Use `dojo.list_skills` to browse by plugin, `dojo.search_skills` to find by keyword, and `dojo.invoke_skill` to load any skill. For Claude Code directly, install from the marketplace as shown above.
